Keikou Sakai (Japanese: 酒井敬幸 Sakai Keikō) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Sakai was born sometime on December 25, in , , and became a voice actor as an adult. He joined the during , but his first notable role was during , where he voiced Team Rocket agent Gozu. Sakai is currently affiliated with the talent agency .
